description: This file contains implementation of POSIX thread management for Zephyr OS on POSIX systems, including thread creation, scheduling, synchronization, cleanup, and internal data structures.

classes.name: threads_table_el
classes.description: Structure representing a thread's state, including its pthread handle, status, and execution state.

methods.name: abort_tail
methods.description: Handles thread abortion and cleanup when a thread is being aborted.

methods.name: posix_wait_until_allowed
methods.description: Blocks a thread until it is allowed to run based on the scheduler control.

methods.name: posix_let_run
methods.description: Allows a specific thread to run by updating the scheduler token and signaling other threads.

methods.name: posix_preexit_cleanup
methods.description: Performs cleanup actions before thread exit, including releasing mutex and detaching thread.

methods.name: posix_swap
methods.description: Switches execution from one thread to another, managing thread scheduling and abortion if needed.

methods.name: posix_main_thread_start
methods.description: Starts the main thread and terminates the initial thread after enabling the specified thread.

methods.name: posix_cleanup_handler
methods.description: Cleanup handler invoked when a thread is cancelled or exits, ensuring proper cleanup.

methods.name: posix_thread_starter
methods.description: Entry point for new POSIX threads, initializing thread execution and handling thread lifecycle.

methods.name: ttable_get_empty_slot
methods.description: Finds or expands the thread table to allocate a new thread slot.

methods.name: posix_new_thread
methods.description: Creates a new POSIX thread for a Zephyr thread, initializing its data structure and starting execution.

methods.name: posix_arch_init
methods.description: Initializes the POSIX architecture, including thread table and synchronization primitives.

methods.name: posix_arch_clean_up
methods.description: Cleans up allocated resources and terminates all threads during shutdown.

methods.name: posix_abort_thread
methods.description: Marks a thread as aborting, signaling it to terminate.

methods.name: posix_arch_get_unique_thread_id
methods.description: Returns a unique identifier for a thread based on its creation order.
